topic: Actual finite kernel quotients and genuine symmetric-power maps on representation parameters

primarySources.title: The p-adic analytic space of pseudocharacters of a profinite group and pseudorepresentations over arbitrary rings
primarySources.author: Gaetan Chenevier
primarySources.locations: Section2.30, especially the discrete-coefficient finite-quotient discussion
primarySources.formalUse: For actual matrix representations, prove openness of the original kernel by continuity of the original matrix coordinates, and apply the pinned compact/open-subgroup quotient theorem. No determinant reconstruction or Amitsur theorem is inferred.

primarySources.title: Symmetric power functoriality for holomorphic modular forms, II
primarySources.authors: James Newton and Jack A. Thorne
primarySources.locations: Introduction and section2: symmetric-power deformation and pseudodeformation maps
primarySources.formalUse: Construct the actual symmetric-power map on algebraic representation coordinate rings and original first-order lifts using previously proved coefficient and conjugacy identities. The arithmetic pseudodeformation map, complete local representability, Selmer inputs and patching are not supplied.
